display.title: {"text": "The Last Charter"}
description: Long before the villages, a frontier survey company strung a line of observatories across the continent: the Lantern Line.
Each station watched one horizon and sent what it saw to the next. The line went dark, the stations fell, and the maps were scattered.
You carry the last charter of the Meridian Survey. Plant it anywhere, restore a station around it, and relight the line one horizon at a time.
Unpack the &eFounding Kit&r, place the &eSurvey Charter&r where your base will grow and right-click it.
The charter's panel shows what each station needs; its &a[Commission]&r button does the work. Friends join by invitation.
&aDo:&r Place a Survey Charter and click Found a headquarters on its panel.
&6You get:&r Your station exists: the charter is its anchor, and every stage below is commissioned there.
